operations.evidence: The current contract, canonical HEAD 4093f768e845fd6fa2db51845be174429ebb651b, UNCLAIMED owner, sequence 36 checkpoint, pickup_requested queue and open H-to-F blocker were verified before writes.
A 15-minute lease was claimed only for official-source and line-by-line website evidence; runtime and business writes remained disabled.
The Police API limit was pinned to 15 requests per second with a burst capacity of 30.
HTTP 429 is treated as an acquisition failure requiring bounded retry and explicit evidence, never as an empty source month.
Custom street-crime polygons containing over 10,000 crimes return HTTP 503 and require bounded subdivision or a recorded failure.
One-mile and polygon street-crime responses remain approximate contextual evidence and not exact parcel incidence.
Stop-search GET requests longer than 4094 characters return HTTP 400; complex polygons require POST rather than truncation.
Area stop-search records remain approximate police-activity context and are excluded from crime-incidence scoring.
Crimes that could not be mapped are available through a force-category-month endpoint with null location fields.
Unmapped crimes are included in completeness diagnostics but cannot be assigned to an LSOA or parcel.
Force-month stop-search records that could not be mapped are exposed separately and are not silently dropped.
A concentration of midnight timestamps may reflect forces supplying dates without times and is not interpreted as operational timing.
Monthly Crime and ASB and Police Outcomes uploads, private-server ingestion and quality assurance were retained as separate provenance stages.
Ministry of Justice court-result matching and publication anonymisation were recorded without implying complete matching or exact location.
Exact coordinates are replaced with the nearest anonymous map point whose catchment contains at least eight addresses or none.
Coordinates are zeroed when no snap point lies within 20 kilometres and the master list edition was refreshed in 2022.
The published 60 to 97 percent force geocoding range was retained as a system limitation and not converted into candidate confidence.
The 19 to 97 percent court-result fuzzy-match range and absence of a unique cross-system crime identifier were retained as outcome limitations.
Later reclassification, false-report confirmation or source-location change may not appear without a complete force refresh, so every extract remains snapshot-pinned.
British Transport Police and Police Service of Northern Ireland outcome absence was retained as a source-coverage limitation.
Full, extent-of-realm, generalised clipped and ultra-generalised ONS boundary products were classified separately.
Generalised boundaries are not silently substituted for an exact edge-sensitive point-in-polygon join, and OGL attribution is retained.
2021 LSOAs were verified as groups of OAs with published household and usual-resident thresholds.
The England inventory was pinned to 33,755 2021 LSOAs; Welsh codes are rejected from the England candidate join.
Population and household changes caused some 2011 LSOAs to be split or merged into 2021 LSOAs.
2011 and 2021 LSOA codes and polygons cannot be mixed without an explicit verified lookup.
The QAAD toolkit was pinned to its 21 May 2026 update and its administrative-data suitability and user-documentation requirements.
QAAD compliance is a governance framework and cannot replace source-specific validation or runtime acceptance.
Police recorded crime requires comprehensive assurance because of high quality risk and high public interest.
Supplier arrangements, force and Home Office checks, independent audit and detailed public documentation remain separate evidence requirements.
Operational context, supplier communication, supplier QA and producer QA investigations were retained as distinct matrix areas.
An asserted or incomplete QA matrix is not promoted without documented checks and audit evidence.
The action plan's representative-force IT-system review was retained as planned quality work rather than completed assurance.
The Data Quality Assurance Manual and proposed annual compliance collection require separate current-status evidence.
